verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs say users can upload documents, spreadsheets, photos and videos to get answers, summaries and insights about their content. They also describe Deep Research over personal Gmail and Drive, Gmail summarization through Connected Apps, and a personalized Daily Brief that surfaces top priorities. Community reports of strong meeting-note analysis and PDF ingestion corroborate the core capability, though some of those reports may concern the API rather than the consumer app. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of proactive, unprompted suggestions beyond the Daily Brief, and independent hands-on corroboration specific to the consumer app's file-insight feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can upload documents, spreadsheets, notebooks, photos, videos, and more to Gemini Apps to get answers, summaries, and insights about your content.
You can change or add other sources, like your personal Gmail or Drive.
Summarize emails from Gmail, create events in Google Calendar or third-party apps, or search for content across a variety of productivity apps.
Your Daily Brief understands your rhythms and personal preferences to deliver your top priorities, organized by importance.
